sources.title: Maldives Immigration: Tourist Visa on Arrival
sources.officialityEvidence: Current official Maldives Immigration tourist-entry page, marked updated 27 August 2025.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Tourist visa is granted on arrival to the Maldives. Foreigners traveling as tourists do not require pre-approval.

sources.title: Maldives Immigration IMUGA: Traveller Declaration
sources.officialityEvidence: Official Maldives Immigration IMUGA portal identifies itself as a Maldives government website and publishes the required arrival declaration.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All travelers are required to submit the Traveller Declaration within 96 hours before their flight time for arrival.

sources.title: Maldives Immigration: Entry into the Maldives is prohibited on Israeli passports
sources.officialityEvidence: Official Maldives Immigration announcement implementing the Third Amendment to the Maldives Immigration Act.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Entry into the Maldives on Israeli passports is prohibited effective from 15th April 2025.

sources.title: Maldives Immigration: Maldivian Passport
sources.officialityEvidence: Official Maldives Immigration passport service page describing ordinary passports issued to Maldivian citizens.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A Maldivian Passport can be issued to any Maldivian citizen who applies for a passport.

policies.title: Maldives: foreign ordinary passports with tourist visa on arrival
policies.summary: Maldives Immigration grants the tourist visa on arrival to foreign tourists without visa pre-approval, subject to the separate Israeli-passport prohibition.
conditions: Applies only to foreign ordinary passports for tourism/short visitor travel. Maldives Immigration says tourist visas are granted on arrival and tourists do not require visa pre-approval.
A Traveller Declaration is mandatory within 96 hours before the arriving flight and is a free self-declaration. It is not an ETA or eVisa and does not replace arrival issuance.

Arrival requires an MRZ passport or travel document with at least one month validity (no extended-validity passports), a complete itinerary with confirmed return journey, prepaid registered accommodation and sufficient funds, or a pre-approved Maldives Immigration sponsorship visa; onward-entry requirements and applicable yellow-fever certification also apply.
Immigration officers determine admissibility at the port of entry. The reviewed current tourist-visa page does not state a fixed initial tourist-visa duration, so this candidate does not infer one.

Does not classify residence, work, business, meeting/conference, dependent, marriage, transit without clearing arrival immigration, crew, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, stateless, emergency or other special-document cases.

policies.title: Maldives: citizenship treatment
policies.summary: The destination's own ordinary-passport code is represented as citizenship rather than a foreign-entry visa result.
conditions: This represents a Maldivian citizen holding an ordinary Maldivian passport, not foreign visitor admission.
Does not classify dual-nationality, foreign residence, diplomatic, official, emergency or other document-specific circumstances.

The candidate schema has no status for an entry prohibition, so this pair is not forced into visa_on_arrival or visa_required; the fallback visa_required result should not be treated as sufficient characterisation.
